svg.title: Жим гантелей с поворотом кистей — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing rotating dumbbell press from oblique side-front view, 45 degrees, so forearm rotation is visible. Left: two independent dumbbells near chin, elbows held ahead of torso and near each other, both palms facing the athlete's face and visible backs of hands. Upper arms project forward rather than sideways. Right: matching athlete presses both dumbbells overhead as palms rotate outward to face forward, elbows fully elevated. Show fully extended upper and lower arms overhead. The end positions must make visible the change in direction of the palms. No ordinary wide goalpost position in left. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
